decision_rule: Diagnostic software acceptance only. The first rowflow dry-run unit is a real production-kernel `/chat` owner-checker request executed under rowflow's short grant/region-lock claim, with isolated attempt output. It must complete the original checker successfully with matched nonempty dispatch/serving blocks, exact loaded b0f8613d65f30986f147e5467b1c66892c887ce5 provenance, native nonnull prompt/cache counts and committed live-check rc=0; tokenizer preflight alone never counts. The dry-run unit is tagged attempt_mode=dryrun, qualification_only=true and is never production completion. A separate scheduled production attempt must write a source-sealed unit tagged attempt_mode=production, qualification_only=false, with nonempty grant hash and the same successful owner receipt. The completion predicate checks production mode, owner receipt hash, request identity, exact source and live-check result. Both modes require matching FILLER_ID and row-specific active grant, and honor engine FILLER_STOPFILE. No performance, traffic-week or promotion claim.
